ValidationRule.description: Prevent all users from modifying the No parent account, including admins.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: IF( OR ( Id = '001Q000000AoN6D', Name = 'SYSTEM USE ONLY - DO NOT MODIFY - NoParentCustAcc' ), OR ( ISCHANGED(Name), NOT( ISBLANK(ParentId) ) ), false)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This account cannot be updated. Please check your change.
